evidence.conflictsToKeep: 16.03M is today's Argon on a third-party board; 28% left is official weekly Argon. Author claims the weekly bar started at 100% today, which is oral. 32.9% on the tooltip is share of today's tokens, not the 72% quota. Cache 70% ≠ quota%. 本周 975.3M is misaligned with a same-day weekly reset. Duplicate post 2121537770711642566 uses the same images; count once. Forbidden: 16.03M÷72% = 22.3M pool.
evidence.why: 官方弹窗只有 Argon 周剩余 28%，没有 token；16.03M 来自第三方「今天」面板。不能当 High 配对，禁止用 16.03M÷72% 反推 22.3M 周池。
